metadata.scope: Real market catalog source layer from official manufacturer collection pages and reputable tennis-retail/product collection pages. Exact product URLs/images are intentionally sparse unless verified at product level.
rules: No generic images are used as product images.
Generic collection pages are stored only as source links, not exact product URLs.
Prices are omitted unless exact product-level price verification exists.
